data.summary: Dirty worktree audited. Existing dashboard/table edits preserved; unrelated staged/backend work left untouched.
Dashboard shell completed with 64px top header, global search, profile/notification controls, sticky filter, KPI, analytics, modules, reports, and status.
Role rules tightened for Payroll Admin, Estate Manager, Finance, and Executive. Sidebar now defaults collapsed and filters items by role.
KPI and analytics cards keep existing summary API wiring and stable fallback cards; chart cards are horizontal-scroll safe.
Dashboard grids changed to safer auto-fit/minmax patterns; cards use 12-16px radii and text-safe responsive constraints.
Scroll-driven active group/focus styles no longer change body cell font weight, text color, or frozen column typography.
ResizeObserver feedback loop reduced by observing container only; table shell now uses parent height and stable min-height.
Row/gang entrance animations disabled for normal table rendering; reduced-motion guard added.
Added guards for role visibility, collapsed sidebar, dashboard header, table ResizeObserver, active-group styling, and animation calm-down.
Focused tests passed, production build passed, HTTP smoke returned 200, dev server running at http://127.0.0.1:5176/. In-app browser unavailable.
